Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Events | National | Top Story Over 80 brands await shoppers on final day of Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair at Ghud Park, Accra Mall Source : Myjoyonline.com 15 November 2026 5:18am ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
There is still time to shop, discover new brands and enjoy exciting offers at the Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026, as the three-day exhibition enters its final day today, Sunday, November 15.
If you have not visited yet, today is your last opportunity to make your way to Ghud Park at Accra Mall and experience an exhibition bringing together more than 80 brands from across Ghana.
From food and beverages to fashion, beauty, agriculture, technology, finance, household products and real estate, visitors can explore a wide range of locally made products and services, meet business owners and take advantage of special deals and discounts.
The fair, powered by Multimedia Group in partnership with Ecobank, has brought together established businesses and emerging brands, giving visitors an opportunity to discover products, support local enterprises and connect directly with the people behind the businesses.
Major participating institutions include Ecobank, MTN, the Ghana Export Promotion Authority (GEPA) and Glico Life.
Other exhibitors include Wilmar Africa, showcasing its Fortune Spread brand; Sintex Tank, offering water storage solutions; DBS, in housing and roofing; and Greenhaul Solutions, which focuses on waste management and scrap procurement.
Whether you are looking to shop, explore new products, discover business opportunities or simply spend time with family and friends, the fair offers an opportunity to do so in one place.
The exhibition has also featured musical performances, including a set from Ghanaian duo Lali X Lola, adding to the atmosphere of shopping, networking and entertainment.
The event builds on the maiden edition held in October 2025, which attracted more than 160 exhibitors and over 1,000 visitors on its opening day.
Organised by the Multimedia Group in partnership with Ecobank, the initiative seeks to give small and medium-sized enterprises greater market access, brand visibility and opportunities to connect with potential customers and business partners.
The Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 closes today, Sunday, November 15.
Visitors are encouraged to pass through Ghud Park, Accra Mall, before the exhibition wraps up and take advantage of the final opportunity to shop, explore and support Ghanaian businesses.
